class.name: go2_rviz_plugins/MapViewer
class.description: Live SLAM map rendered with QPainter (not RViz's OGRE scene), click to send a Nav2 goal, Cancel button to cancel it.

class.name: go2_rviz_plugins/AutoMapper
class.description: Start/stop controls and live log output for the autonomous frontier-exploration mapper (go2_auto_mapper).

class.name: go2_rviz_plugins/KeyboardTeleop
class.description: Drive the robot by holding keys while this panel has focus. Publishes /cmd_vel_keyboard directly from Qt key events, same controls as keyboard_teleop.
